name: uberasm-hypothermia
title: Hypothermia
description:
With this code, the player will die from cold if they stand still for too long. They will begin to shake as a sign of warning before dying. They can also get hurt or instantly killed if they try to swim in water if set to do so.

Defines for the amount of frames it takes for the player to die, when to make the player shake, give immunity when star power is active, and whether to hurt or instantly kill or not when touching water are included.
